name: web-onboarding-username
title: Onboarding: choose your username (live availability check)
issue: USER-APPROVED onboarding username step. Backend usernames are MERGED and DEPLOYED (Qamooscheh-Backend PR #46); the contract is the usernames section of C:/Users/epicn/source/repos/Qamooscheh/src/Qamooscheh.Api/API_SPEC.md (read it first, do not guess shapes). Rules: handle 3-20 chars of lowercase letters, digits, _ and ., unique case-insensitively. Every account already has an auto-assigned handle; choosing one in onboarding is the first/auto-replacement change: it is free but STARTS the 30-day rename clock, and the UI must say so before the user confirms. BUILD an optional username step in onboarding: (1) instant local format check as the user types (trim, lowercase, optional leading @ stripped); (2) availability check about 400ms after typing stops (debounce), cancelling stale in-flight requests so an old response never overwrites a newer one; show a spinner while checking, then a tick or the specific reason (taken, held, blocked, invalid); the check shares the 30/min rate limit with search, so map 429 to friendly copy and do not fire for locally-invalid input; (3) server re-check on submit (the availability result can be stale): map any rejection to copy and keep the user on the step; (4) Skip keeps the auto-assigned handle and does not start the clock; (5) user-facing copy follows the CLAUDE.md terminology. Web: read CLAUDE.md, the existing onboarding flow and the friends-usernames rename UI first; reuse the existing username API client and validation helpers rather than duplicating them. Add tests for the debounce and stale-request cancellation.
